## Appearance

Hugh is an exceptionally good-looking, high-statured youth with broad shoulders, wavy chestnut hair, and mischievous light-brown or hazel eyes. He has an open-faced expression and a mouth that frequently contorts into a mocking or humorous grin. As he grows older, he develops a remarkably tall, manly, and broad-shouldered appearance.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c28 P32](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0032), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

Hugh is a smart, mischievous youth who possesses independent perspectives and a strong resolve to extract the finest elements from life while contributing his utmost. He is fond of teasing others, but he also exhibits deep consideration, generosity, and chivalry toward his friends. Possessing high moral standards, he guards his speech and actions to remain worthy of high ideals and respectable companionship.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051)_

## History

After spending three years in Alberta due to his father's illness and visiting cousins in New Brunswick, Hugh returned to school in Brierley. He quickly established an intense but friendly academic rivalry with Nell Harcourt, which continued through their studies at Regent's Academy. Hugh won the medal upon graduating from Regent's Academy. Intending to fund his own higher education, Hugh planned to teach school; he generously revoked his application for the Brierley school so Nell could take it, taking a position at Pale Sands instead. He became an active organizer and the president of the Brierley Village Improvement Society, while also anonymously contributing local notes to the Port Marlow Daily Enterprise under the pen name 'Observer'. After completing his teaching engagement at Pale Sands, he prepared to leave for Wexcombe College in late August alongside Nell.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c24 P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000), [v2 c24 P1](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0001), [v2 c25 P70](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0070), [v2 c30 P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000)_
